The dav2-gpu-fp16.onnx and dav2-gpu-mx-fp16-head.onnx models are derived
from Depth Anything V2 Small by Lihe Yang, Bingyi Kang,
Zilong Huang, Zhen Zhao, Xiaogang Xu, Jiashi Feng and Hengshuang Zhao.
The Small model is licensed under Apache License 2.0. See the accompanying
depth-anything-v2-small-LICENSE.txt.

Original project: https://github.com/DepthAnything/Depth-Anything-V2
Source ONNX export: https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/depth-anything-v2-small/tree/4472b7362082ad9968fee890ca0f1e5aca36b93d

ParallelEyeConverter modifies dav2-gpu-fp16.onnx to support variable input
sizes, FP16 weights and computation, and the Android QNN GPU backend.
Source for this variant: https://github.com/7116-byte/ParallelEyeConverter/blob/7059fb36b76662acd5b643c129259939e3dd4f1b/app/src/main/assets/dav2-gpu-fp16.onnx

ParallelVrGalleryPro also derives dav2-gpu-mx-fp16-head.onnx from the
source FP32 weights. Its final three depth convolutions retain FP32
precision while most operators use FP16.
